issues.problem: Distractor ぞ is natural self-talk on noticing something wrong (あれ、鍵がないぞ), so the item had two right answers.
issues.action: Rewrote the line as a gentle musing where ぞ is plainly wrong: この写真の父は若いなあ。

issues.action: Distractors changed to ぜ, の, よ.

issues.jp_before: 桜[さくら]{が|ga-subject}もう咲[さ]いている{な|na-musing}。
